info.description: Web services for the activation and management of Certified Email (PEC). These services allow you to register a new certified mailbox, as well as renew or revoke existing accounts. You can also modify mailbox options such as total storage and archive space, or enable and expand legally compliant preservation. Furthermore, the system includes methods to report a certified email address to the Business Register. Finally, you can use these services to download and upload activation forms for both the mailbox and the legal preservation service. All endpoints that take an id only operate on resources owned by the authenticated account: an id belonging to another account returns the same 404 error as an id that does not exist.

tipo_casella.description: type of mailbox. STANDARD/BRONZE/SILVER/GOLD/MASSIVA1-3 are provisioned via InfoCert; DOMICILIODIGITALE/PECMASSIVA are provisioned via Namirial. The provider is derived from this value (plus the domain), not chosen separately, and it determines which of the other BodyPostPec fields actually apply (see their descriptions). The type must match the provider of the domain: an InfoCert type on a Namirial domain (domiciliodigitale.com, pecmassiva.com) or a Namirial type on an InfoCert domain (legalmail.it) returns error 505.

sottotipo_cliente.description: The customer subtype. Validated against the DB-driven 'tipologie' lookup collection, not a fixed list — which valid codes apply depends on 'tipo_cliente'; see the TipologieCliente schema for the per-tipo_cliente code tables.

email.description: standard email address of the applicant

telefono.description: phone number of the applicant. InfoCert: required, numeric, 11 characters maximum. Namirial (DOMICILIODIGITALE/PECMASSIVA): ignored and saved empty.

cellulare.description: mobile phone number of the applicant. Namirial (DOMICILIODIGITALE/PECMASSIVA): required, with the international prefix (e.g. +393490000000). InfoCert: optional, numeric.

data_nascita_richiedente.description: date of birth of the applicant (dd/mm/yyyy). InfoCert: required for every tipo_cliente. Namirial (DOMICILIODIGITALE/PECMASSIVA): required for private clients (tipo_cliente PV), optional and saved as sent for the others. On Namirial it is needed to activate the conservation service later for every client type, so send it if conservation will be requested.

sesso_richiedente.description: gender of the applicant; M or F. InfoCert: required for every tipo_cliente. Namirial (DOMICILIODIGITALE/PECMASSIVA): required for private clients (tipo_cliente PV), optional and saved as sent for the others. On Namirial it is needed to activate the conservation service later for every client type, so send it if conservation will be requested.

nazione_nascita_richiedente.description: country of birth of the applicant. InfoCert: required for every tipo_cliente, 2 characters maximum (e.g. IT). Namirial (DOMICILIODIGITALE/PECMASSIVA): optional, saved as sent. On Namirial it is needed to activate the conservation service later for every client type, so send it if conservation will be requested.

comune_nascita_richiedente.description: city of birth of the applicant. InfoCert: optional. Namirial (DOMICILIODIGITALE/PECMASSIVA): required for private clients (tipo_cliente PV), optional and saved as sent for the others. On Namirial it is needed to activate the conservation service later for every client type, so send it if conservation will be requested.

provincia_nascita_richiedente.description: province of birth of the applicant. 3 characters maximum. InfoCert: optional. Namirial (DOMICILIODIGITALE/PECMASSIVA): required for private clients (tipo_cliente PV), optional and saved as sent for the others. On Namirial it is needed to activate the conservation service later for every client type, so send it if conservation will be requested.

Dominio.description: GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE all return the domain record as stored in MongoDB pretty much as-is (only a handful of fields are stripped, see individual endpoints). On some InfoCert domains this includes fields not written by any current API code path — 'anagrafica_sincronizzata', 'pec_attive', 'pec_totali', 'sottotipo_cliente', 'telefono' (all documented below) — plus Italian-language 'dns'/'config'/'certif' values (e.g. 'CORRETTO'/'ERRATO') written by the async cron (CronAutorinnovo), which reads them from InfoCert's XML interface (InfocertDominiClient::getStatoDominio) — DominioInfoCert::sincronizza only updates stato_fornitore — as opposed to the English 'OK'/'KO' produced by the REST integration used at initial activation.

Callback.description: Standardized callback configuration. Enables receiving notifications about status updates of asynchronous requests.

method.description: Specify the callback method. When set to 'POST', a standard HTTP POST request will be initiated with Content-Type application/x-www-form-urlencoded. The JSON data will be encoded into a key-value pair named 'data' (customizable via the 'field' parameter). When set to 'JSON', a direct HTTP POST request will be made with Content-Type application/json and the raw JSON body.

field.description: Works with method='POST'. Determines the name of the parameter sent in the POST request body. Always set: 'data' when not sent, also with method='JSON' (where it is not used).

url.description: A valid URL capable of handling POST requests. For authenticated endpoints use the 'headers' parameter. Maximum timeout is 30 seconds. If 'retry' is set, the system retries until a 200 status code is received.

retry.description: Maximum number of retry attempts. Retries only on temporary errors (e.g. 502, 503) or network issues, with exponential backoff. Maximum value is 5.

headers.description: HTTP headers to send with the callback request. Useful for authentication (basic auth, bearer auth) or custom metadata.

custom.description: Additional data to include in the callback payload, accessible in the 'custom' key of the callback body. Can be any JSON value (object, array, string, number), at most 512 bytes once JSON-encoded (otherwise the request is rejected).

post.description: Before calling this endpoint, the customer must configure an MX record on their domain's own DNS pointing to the provider's mail server: 'mx.cert.legalmail.it' for InfoCert, 'mailpro.sicurezzapostale.it' for Namirial. This check is skipped for internal legalmail.it subdomains and in test environments (AMBIENTE_TEST_DOMINI). If the MX record is missing or incorrect, the request fails with error 714. In addition to the local DB check, the domain is also checked against the central domain registry (the same lookup used by GET /domini_pec/{dominio}), unless its MX record already points to the chosen provider's mail server (the registry would detect the provider's MX, not a real registration); if already censito there, the request fails with error 712 (InfoCert) or 732 (Namirial), and if the registry lookup itself fails the request fails with error 710 (503).

delete.description: Revokes the domain and its associated PEC mailboxes. Mailboxes already in 'evasa' state are revoked through the provider; the mailbox callback is sent only for InfoCert mailboxes. Mailboxes not yet active (any other state except 'revocata') are soft-deleted directly to 'revocata' without contacting the provider. If the provider refuses to revoke a mailbox, the others are still processed and the refused ones are listed in the notification to the operators. The domain itself is set to 'revocato' in our DB, but it is revoked at the provider manually: the operators receive a notification to do it in the provider's panel. The domain callback, if configured, is sent.

patch.description: Perform one or more operations on a PEC mailbox in a single call with a single billing checkout: upload activation documents, renew, upgrade box type, modify storage/options, activate conservation, and/or add multi-user accounts. At least one operation must be specified. Activation (ModuloAttivazione) requires stato registrata/documenti_errati; all other operations require stato evasa (rinnovo also accepts revocata). When ModuloAttivazione is sent together with other operations, they are all charged in the same checkout but, since the box is not active yet, they are saved on the box (rinnovo_anni increased, new space totals, options, multiutenza users, conservation pending) and applied at the provider when an operator activates it; they are listed in 'operazioni_in_attesa_di_attivazione' (conservation instead in 'operazioni_eseguite') and the box stays in_evasione. 'upgrade_casella' cannot be combined with ModuloAttivazione (error 704, before any charge). Several fields are InfoCert-only: 'upgrade_casella' always fails on Namirial (error 609, no tiers to upgrade to, before any charge), and 'phishing_protection'/'password_protection'/'norma_ai'/'invio_massivo_pec' have no effect there. 'multiutenza' also behaves differently per provider (a real per-user list on InfoCert vs a single on/off service on Namirial, with no individual user management). See field descriptions below and the 'combined_namirial' example. Billing (InfoCert): services and space activated after registration (phishing_protection, password_protection, norma_ai, extra space, conservation packages, multiutenza and each user) are charged at the full annual price, regardless of the months remaining until the mailbox expires.

documenti.description: Documents to upload; each item must have 'tipo' (ModuloAttivazione|richiestaConservazione) and 'file' (base64-encoded PDF). This only stages the documents — real provider-side activation is done later by an operator, not through this API. For 'richiestaConservazione': InfoCert needs just 1 document; Namirial needs exactly 2, in order (1st = conservation contract, 2nd = privacy disclosure; error 726 otherwise): Namirial accepts a single document, so they are merged into one PDF when an operator activates conservazione. 'richiestaConservazione' requires 'spazio_conservazione' (error 727). All documents must be PDF (error 528), checked before any charge.

Space fields (spazio_disco, spazio_storico, spazio_conservazione) accept an integer (absolute value) or a string prefixed with '+' for incremental increase (e.g. '+1024'). patch.description: This method allows you to activate the standard storage service in your certified e-mail. Supported for all mailbox types including DOMICILIODIGITALE and PECMASSIVA (Namirial). This only stages the request (space + documents) — real provider-side activation is done later by an operator, not through this API. Conservation space is sold in packages of 512 MB on InfoCert and 1 GB (1024 MB) on Namirial. Conservation space is bought at registration (POST /pec, spazio_conservazione); this call uploads the signed documents and does not charge that space again. Only space beyond what was already paid is charged here, at the full annual price. On Namirial the space cannot exceed the archive space (error 607). InfoCert needs just 1 document ('documenti' as a plain string or a 1-item array); Namirial needs exactly 2, passed in order (1st = conservation contract, 2nd = privacy disclosure; error 726 otherwise, before any charge): Namirial accepts a single document, so they are merged into one PDF when an operator activates conservazione — see the 'namirial' request example.

spazio_conservazione.description: Conservation space bought at registration (POST /pec) is already paid and is kept. If this parameter is not passed, that space is used (if none was bought: 512 MB on InfoCert, 1024 MB on Namirial); a higher value or '+N' charges only the packages beyond the space already paid; a lower value returns error 289.

get.description: This method allows you to renew (1-3 years, query parameter 'anni') or re-activate the certified e-mail identified by the id. The mailbox always keeps the day and month of its previous expiration date: the new expiration date is the previous one plus the renewed years if the mailbox expired less than 6 months ago (InfoCert) or less than 1 month ago (Namirial), otherwise the last anniversary already passed plus the renewed years (the yearly cycle continues; e.g. expired on 15/03/2025, renewed on 10/10/2026 for 1 year → 15/03/2027). A revoked mailbox can be renewed only within those limits (error 252).

parameters.name: anni
parameters.description: Number of years for which you want to renew the pec box (1-3). If not passed it is 1 by default. Values above 3 are silently clamped down to 3; non-numeric or values below 1 return error 649.
